$comment: Core files copied into every host plugin, in this order, before the adapter's own copy list (adapters/<host>/assemble.json). One list so a new core directory cannot be missing from one host. The binary embeds what it reads (studio, kits, assets, templates, the MCP guide); a plugin carries only its launchers (bin/), the texts the host and agent read (skills, agents, templates, schemas) and its manifest.
